item.coloph: snyan dngags kyi me long / slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /phul du byung ba'i yon tan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che pa dang / dpon chen shAkya bzang po'i bka' lung gis/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan dngags mkhan chen shrI lak+Sh+mI ka ra dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba dge slong shong ston gyi dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por legs par bsgyur pa'o/ slar yang shong ston de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis legs par sbyar ba la brda spyod ba'i tshul rig pa dbang po tsA ba dpal ldan bla gros brtan pas/ slob dpon chen po rat+na shrI yis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang mthun par 'gyur bcas su rung ba rnams bsgyur te/ zhus chen cung zad g.yar khral du 'tshal pa'o
slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long

translator.name: rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan ngag mkhan chen po shrI la k+Sh+mI ka ra
bod kyi lo tsA ba dge slong shong ston
snye thang blo brtan bzhi pa
dpang lo tsA ba blo gros brtan pa
